title: CRM/ITSM integration design: ServiceNow vs Salesforce
scenario: LFG's IT help desk works in ServiceNow and its HR People Desk in Salesforce Service Cloud; both move onto one LFG-owned Connect instance. Recommend the agent desktop and integration for each, including Amazon Connect CTI Adapter vs Service Cloud Voice, screen pops and contact-to-ticket logging, for an architecture review board.
task: Compare realistic ServiceNow and Salesforce integration options and who owns the Connect instance in each
Recommend an architecture with screen pop, click-to-dial and context passing
Design idempotent, event-driven contact-to-ticket logging with 7-year traceability
Cover SSO, multi-LOB access control on one instance, operations and risks; end with an ADR
acceptance: Accurate CTI Adapter vs Service Cloud Voice (bundle vs partner telephony) distinctions
Requirements R1-R10 traced; logging idempotent and event-driven
Clear diagram, walkthroughs and decision record

practices.label: Week 7 - ServiceNow and Salesforce integration patterns
Week 2 - solution design documents and decision records
Week 9 - SSO and tag-based access control
